ideal: The two 8-Ks (NVIDIA, Alphabet executive/director changes) are material news she asked for; the Eli Lilly PRE 14A is proxy paperwork she explicitly does not want. An alert naming both 8-Ks in plain words with links, excluding the proxy, is the right answer; [SILENT] would be wrong here.

verdicts.note: Flags both 8-Ks, correctly drops the Lilly proxy, no invented details. Ticker-only labels and clipped phrasing read a bit like raw data, but accurate and clean.
